_comment: Blank-core infra template. The DOMAIN (goal, metric, connector impl, actions) lives in the pack, not here. When you drop in a domain pack, use ITS config.json (which adds connector params + domain paths + a recommended allow_list). Edit provider keys via .env.
_backend_comment: HOW a model is reached. "http" (default) is every OpenAI-compatible provider below; --fake-llm selects the offline backend. claudeCode runs the analyze pass on your own Claude Code subscription (no api key) - see the claudeCode block below.
_claudeCode_comment: Agent-CLI backend (backend: claudeCode): runs the analyze pass on your own Claude Code subscription instead of an api key, reaching this deploy's tools over MCP. bin empty = claude from PATH; model empty = the CLI default (e.g. opus | sonnet); timeout is seconds for the whole turn - it runs the entire tool loop. oneShotModel: the model for one-shot calls routed to the CLI (see one_shot); empty = model.
_one_shot_comment: WHERE one-shot calls go (an LLM-judged metric; analyze when analyze_tool_steps is 0) - routed apart from the agentic analyze pass, which goes to backend. A key of providers = that HTTP provider; claudeCode = the CLI on your subscription (--json-schema, ~6 s per call, no api key). Empty = provider when one is configured, else the backend itself - so a claudeCode deploy without any provider needs no api key at all.
_providers_comment: each provider optionally takes: timeout (seconds per request, default 120) and max_retries (default 2; SDK backoff on 429/5xx/connection errors), temperature (default 0.2; null = not sent, for models that refuse one), max_tokens (output cap; unset = the provider's default; a reply cut off at it fails the pass with that message instead of a JSON error), retry_transient_400 (default true: retry a 4xx once - right for OpenRouter's per-request routing, one wasted call on a direct provider). Gemini free tier allows 5 requests/min and one agentic pass makes ~10: set max_retries ~8 there so the SDK waits out the limit instead of failing the pass
_schedule_comment: run-loop (unattended): interval between ticks (90s / 15m / 1h); until = local HH:MM end, empty = run until Ctrl+C; passes_per_day / tokens_per_day = budget over a rolling 24 h counted from the log, 0 = no limit (a tick over budget is skipped); max_backoff = the longest wait after repeated failures. Command-line --interval / --until / --ticks override.
_metric_targets_comment: Optional: when the loop is DONE. With no new input a pass runs while any target is unmet; it stops with 'goal reached' (all met) or 'stopped improving' (no targeted metric beat its best value in convergence_runs passes). number = at least; {"max": n} = at most. Keys are the pack's metric keys.
_git_comment: OPTIONAL git versioning of the materialized artifacts. Disabled unless enabled=true. repo_dir MUST be a PRE-INITIALIZED git repo rooted exactly there (run `git init` yourself) and MUST NOT be the project's source repo. granularity: per_run|per_action. Leave remote empty for local-only; set it (e.g. origin) to also push. Command-line variant (uses your existing git auth).
